description: Awarded results for a similar item, as a free summary: how many results, the median and the range (p25/p75) of the same catalog product in the same unit, without the extremes; the volume bought; the value for your quantity; and the other groups that the search found (ask for the product and the unit of one of them to switch). It searches awarded results by item description: PNCP results and the items that Ceará cities report to TCE-CE (`fonte` on each item). It also accepts POST, PUT or PATCH with the same parameters in JSON or a form; `query`, `termo`, `busca` and `search` count as `q`, `estado` as `uf`, and `limit` as `limite`. Every 400 has `exemplo` and `doc`.

catmat.description: Item code in the government catalog (optional).

quantidade.description: How much you will sell: the value for the range of that quantity (optional).
